name: Overseer of the House of Truth
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Overseer of the House of Truth (Origin)
Source Pathfinder #139: The Dead Road pg. 73
Your creator was a politician and administrator, and your memories are filled with the sound of clinking coins.

Prerequisites: Shabti.

Benefit: You gain a second daily use of your suggestion spell-like ability. You gain a third daily use at 8th level, a fourth at 13th level, and a fifth at 16th level.
